title: Outdoor Kitchen quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install a custom outdoor kitchen at the Johnsons' residence. Includes a Beefeater Signature ProLine five-burner built-in BBQ. Four point two linear metres of Caesarstone 'Raw Concrete' benchtop, 600mm deep, with waterfall end panel. Three linear metres of marine-grade aluminium cabinetry in 'Charcoal', comprising a double-door under-BBQ unit, a single-door sink unit, and a two-drawer unit. Franke Sinos SNX210-40 stainless steel undermount sink with a Clark Round Gooseneck mixer tap. Installation of ten linear metres of new gas line from the existing meter to the BBQ. Electrical rough-in and fit-off for two double weather-resistant GPOs and wiring for three LED strip lights under the benchtop. Includes removal of existing small BBQ cart and site tidy-up.
workingDetail: Built-in BBQ or cooktop, Stone or granite benchtop, Outdoor cabinetry (marine grade), Sink and tapware
